reason: The inference from (A_4) to ambient openness is not justified. A C^1 diffeomorphism onto its image is a local diffeomorphism only relative to that image, so it does not by itself imply that S_delta_* is open in the ambient real manifold calX; for example t |-> (t,0) is a diffeomorphism R onto its image in R^2, whose image is not ambient-open. The allowed lem-stage1-smooth-polar-inverse contract explicitly requires a bijective C^1 local diffeomorphism onto an open subset of ambient calX. Under the present hypotheses this may be repairable by proving dim_R(calU x B_delta_*^calH(J))=dim_R(calX), proving the ambient differential of Pi_delta_* is injective/isomorphic, and applying the finite-dimensional inverse-function theorem, but node 1.1.1 supplies none of that and no allowed dependency contract exports this intermediate ambient-openness conclusion. Therefore the stated application of lem-stage1-smooth-polar-inverse has an unmet hypothesis.
